participating-org.narrative: Agricultural technologies and services Center (Center) is a business unit-public under An Giang’s Department of Agriculture and rural development. The functions of center shall be as bellows: - To implement the inspection, testing and accreditation of quality, and organize the supply and service of plant varieties and animal breeds; - To implement public services of sampling and testing agricultural materials, quality of agro-forestry products, fisheries and salt testing, diagnosing and treating diseases for livestock, poultry, aquatic products and livestock; participate in standard and regulation conformity certification activities in the field of quality of agricultural, forestry, fishery and salt products; provide technical services and professional training on the quality of agricultural materials, food safety, agro-forestry-fishery and salt; vocational training and education in the field of agriculture; provide quality certification, good agricultural practice; organize scientific and technological activities in the field of quality of agricultural materials, food safety of agriculture, forestry, fishery and salt; provide services to promote trade in agriculture, forestry, fishery and salt, agricultural materials in the field, management of the agricultural sector and rural development. The tasks of Center shall be as follows: 1. To implement inspection, sampling and testing plant and animal varieties, serving as a basis for granting certificates of quality of plant varieties and livestock breeds in conformity with standards and technical regulations for other plant and animal breeds. organizations and individuals that produce and trade in plant and animal breeds inside and outsidethe province. At the same time as a basis to evaluate the quality of plant varieties and livestock being produced and traded in theprovince. 2. To assist the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development in providing professional guidance to organizations and individuals registering for inspection, testing, and seed production and trading. 3. To produce and trade in plant and animal breedsto supply organizations and individuals inside and outside the province. 4. To coordinate with concerned units and seed production facilities in the province to research, receive, transfer and widely apply technological processes to produce new and disease-free varieties; popularize and widely transfer new effective seed production models and technologies; participate in propaganda work so that people strictly comply with theState's regulations on seed production and trading. 5. To implement inspection, testing and selection of plant and animal varieties to advise the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development in recognizing the quality of varieties, strains and individuals in the province according to the breed management decentralization. by the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development and according to the regulations of the Provincial People's Committee. 6. Joint venture, association, research, processing, production and supply of plant varieties and livestock as required. To consult projects on plant varieties and livestock in accordance with the law. 7. To chair or coordinate with concerned agencies in formulating regulations and standards on plant varietiesand livestock as assigned by competent agencies. 8. To participate in the implementation of agricultural extension projects, building demonstration models and training to transfer scientific and technical advances in seed work into production. 9. To implement policies on investment and support for plant varieties and livestock breeds in the province as assigned by competent authorities. 10. To check production conditions; check and certify that batches of seeds are in conformity with the standards; toproduce and trade plant varieties; to check growing conditions and assessment of the quality of plants and animals in the field of plant varieties andlivestock. 11. To implement sampling, analysis, and testing services a) Research and apply regulations of Vietnam, international organizations, regions and importing countries on criteria, limits, testing methods under the responsibility of the Center; b) Providesampling, analysis and testing services for food safety and quality of agricultural, forestry, aquatic products and salt; c) Analyze quality assessment criteria on samples such as: soil, water, air, agricultural products, aquatic products, packaged food, food processing additives, animal feed, medicinal herbs, veterinary drugs, pesticides andfertilizers. d) Test and diagnose animal and aquatic diseases; 12. To participate in standard and regulation conformity certification activities in the field of quality of agricultural, forestry, fishery and salt products. 13. To provide the followingservices: a) Consultancy on recognition the quality of crop products meeting VietGap standards and other standards as prescribed; product certification in conformity with standards and regulationsin the field of quality of agricultural, forestry, fishery and salt products. b) Consultancy, production and trading in plant varieties and livestock according to regulations. c) Certify and assess the quality of agricultural materials, food safety of agro-forestry-fisheries and salt at the request of customers; d) Consultancy on the satisfaction of regulations on certification of food safetyconditions for agricultural, forestry, fishery and salt production and trading establishments and regulations on material production and trading establishments agriculturalinvestment. e) Implement service activities, verify and trace causes of food insecurity andproposing solutions and measures to ensure food quality and safety. f) Consultancy on product announcement, standard conformity andregulation conformity (outside the field of assessment and certification) of the agricultural sector; g) Consultancy on processing and preservation of agricultural, forestry, fishery and salt products; h) Provide other services related to the quality of agricultural materials, foodsafety of agricultural, forestry, aquatic products and salt. 14. Professional training, vocational training: a) Professional training: Organize training and professional skills on food safety for individuals/organizations producing and trading inagriculture, forestry, fishery and salt; b) Vocational training: Participate in vocational education and training in agriculture atelementary level and continue training for less than 3 months and grant certificates as prescribed to the following occupationalgroups: salt production, processing and preservation of agricultural products, forest products, aquatic products, agriculture, cultivation, animal husbandry, veterinary medicine. c) Organize professional and vocational training on inspection, sampling and testing of plant varieties. 15. To assess and certify quality of agricultural materials, food safety for agricultural, forestry, aquatic products and salt; good agricultural practices in the fields of cultivation, aquaculture, animal husbandry (VietGAP, VietGHAP) and other food safety management systems in food production and trading. 16. To chair or cooperate in scientific research activities, application of technological advances and specialized techniques in the fields of quality of agricultural materials, food safety of agriculture, forestry, fishery and salt. when assigned by the competent authorities. Participate in the implementation of science and technology projects at home and abroad in the fields of agriculture, forestry, fisheries,salt, plant varieties and livestock. 17. To propose, formulate and submit to competent authorities programs and projects in the field of quality and food safety of agriculture, forestry, fishery and salt; organize the implementation after being approvedby the competent authority. 18. Provide services on trade promotion of agriculture, forestry, fishery and salt, agricultural materials, public services in the agricultural sector as prescribed by law.
